input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination. Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Section 6 (and the duplicate termination text at p0044) addresses only final payment and assignment of Works in progress; it says nothing about transition assistance, return of Company data or deletion/certification. Section 4 covers ownership of Works but not delivery back of our data, and the confidentiality provision (p0038-p0040) imposes only use/disclosure restrictions with no return-or-destroy obligation. No usable clause exists anywhere in the Agreement, so the rule is missing. We inserted the preferred position at Section 6(c): up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of Company data, Works and Confidential Information within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter; 90 days of assistance with a 30-day export would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days, return to Company all Company data, Works and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data, Works and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard exit provision: on termination we can purchase up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, and our data, Works and Confidential Information are returned within 30 days in a machine-readable format and then deleted with written certification. The Agreement is currently silent on data return and wind-down, which leaves us without access to our own records; we can accept 90 days of transition assistance as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation in Section 6
